title: River Lamp: Four Scenes
sourceTitle: Original verse; not quoted from classical texts and not attributed to any real poet.

scenes.title: Dusk Crossing
scenes.narration: Clouds clear east of the little bridge, and reed shadows sway in a light breeze. Who set a lamp afloat on the water, lighting home a few calling swallows?
scenes.sourceQuote: Clouds clear east of the little bridge, and reed shadows sway in a light breeze. Who set a lamp afloat on the water, lighting home a few calling swallows?

scenes.title: Moonlit Shore
scenes.narration: The moon rises slowly off the far shore; grass greens the empty path. Hills and stream are hushed, and a lit window waits for the traveler.
scenes.sourceQuote: The moon rises slowly off the far shore; grass greens the empty path. Hills and stream are hushed, and a lit window waits for the traveler.

scenes.title: Reading at Night
scenes.narration: Opening old pages, I hear rain in the pines; writing new lines, I see a distant shore. Where is warmth tonight? In clear tea and one bright lamp.
scenes.sourceQuote: Opening old pages, I hear rain in the pines; writing new lines, I see a distant shore. Where is warmth tonight? In clear tea and one bright lamp.

scenes.title: Home at Dawn
scenes.narration: Dawn mist opens on the ferry landing, and lamplight finds the one returning. The line still unfinished in my heart, I write into the coming spring.
scenes.sourceQuote: Dawn mist opens on the ferry landing, and lamplight finds the one returning. The line still unfinished in my heart, I write into the coming spring.
